note: R15 fill B: designed spaces in the gaps of Stage Three (The Expanse) and the land east of x 250. Each site is composed at load by plan_fill_b.js from its program, checked cell by cell against everything already built (buildings, roads, paths, plazas, venues, keep-outs, colliders, solids, module meshes), and tied to the nearest walk by a short spur.

sites.name: Mesquite Bosque
sites.card: A shaded bosque of mesquite and palo verde between Main Street and Mesa Heights: a ramada, a chess table, benches under the canopy and a desert garden along the walk.

sites.name: Bosque Fountain Court
sites.card: A small cantera fountain in a court of palo verde, with a stone runnel that carries its water to the walk. Benches face the water.

sites.name: Bosque Garden Walk
sites.card: A desert garden where the Main Street walk meets the bosque: a saguaro stand, agave and grass drifts and a curved stone bench.

sites.name: Range Windmill
sites.card: Where Main Street gives way to open range: an old windmill over a dry stock tank, a split rail and a bench. A favourite photo spot at sunset.

sites.name: Backstreet Grove
sites.card: A shade grove behind the Main Street storefronts, with benches and a desert garden: a quiet place off the boardwalk.

sites.name: Hammock Grove
sites.card: Hammocks strung between timber posts under palo verde shade, a short walk from the Fireside. Lie back and watch the light through the leaves.

sites.name: Glamping Star Benches
sites.card: Reclined timber benches on a gravel pad facing the dark southern sky, for the glamping village's stargazers. Lights stay low after dusk.

sites.name: Glamping Fire Circle
sites.card: A fieldstone fire circle with benches round it, under mesquite, for the glamping tents nearby. Lit every evening.

sites.name: Glamping Desert Garden
sites.card: A desert garden of agave, ocotillo and grass drifts round a stand of saguaro, with a curved stone bench.

sites.name: Sculpture Walk
sites.card: A gravel trail through the sculpture fields: five pieces by the district's artists, each on its own pad with a note on the work.

sites.name: Art Garden
sites.card: A corten ring over a bed of grasses and agave at the heart of the Design District: a frame for the mountains beyond.

sites.name: Desert Labyrinth
sites.card: A walking labyrinth laid in fieldstone on decomposed granite, ringed by ocotillo. One path in, one path out: walk it slowly.

sites.name: Water Wall
sites.card: A rammed-earth wall with a thin sheet of water falling into a stone trough, a few steps from the Flagship Pavilion.

sites.name: Fountain Court Garden
sites.card: A steel pergola over a garden room of benches and desert planting, where the Fountain Court estates meet the Commons.

sites.name: Native Plant Trail
sites.card: A short loop past the plants of the Sonoran desert, each with a sign: saguaro, ocotillo, agave, palo verde, mesquite and barrel cactus.

sites.name: Sunset Lookout
sites.card: A timber deck on a low rise, facing west over the runway to the Mule Mountains. The best seat on the bluff at sunset.

sites.name: Bluff Grove
sites.card: A grove of ironwood and palo verde with benches, between the bluff homes and the Works.

sites.name: Bluff Garden
sites.card: A small desert garden of agave and barrel cactus round a saguaro stand, with a curved stone bench.

sites.name: Corral Viewing Stand
sites.card: Timber bleachers above the corral for rodeo nights, team roping and the Saturday horse shows, under a mesquite at each end.

sites.name: Chuckwagon Camp
sites.card: A ranch-hand fire circle beside the Frontier Ranch, with benches and mesquite shade: coffee in the morning, stories after dark.

sites.name: Launch Field Star Benches
sites.card: Reclined benches on the dark north side of the Launch Complex, for meteor showers and the launches.

sites.name: Gate Saguaro Garden
sites.card: A stand of saguaro in a desert garden at the Expanse Gate, with a curved bench: the first garden you meet coming up into The Expanse.

sites.name: Meteorite Garden
sites.card: Red rocks and organ pipe cactus round a ring of dark stone: a garden for the off-world frontier, near the Genesis Ring.

sites.name: Outpost Star Benches
sites.card: Reclined benches on the dark-sky edge of The Outpost. No lights here after dusk.

sites.name: Works Yard Grove
sites.card: A low planted berm with a mesquite grove, screening the Works yards from the homes on the bluff.

sites.name: Mesa Garden
sites.card: A desert garden of agave and grass drifts round a saguaro stand, below the Mesa Heights homes.

sites.name: North Yard Grove
sites.card: A planted berm and mesquite grove screening the event parking.

hammock: You can hear the whole valley from here.
